Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
In one of the most endearing clearings in the forest, you can find cute critters and beautiful beasties hiding behind every bramble, all brought to life with delightful art by Aya Kakeda. And if you keep your eyes peeled, you might even catch a glimpse of a lovely little Nature’s Will (we haven’t seen a new one of those since 2004). But watch out, these charming little paws and claws are still sharp.

Contents:
• 1x Foil Joraga Treespeaker
• 1x Foil Nature’s Will
• 1x Foil Ulvenwald Tracker
• 1x Foil Yeva, Nature’s Herald
